faqs.q: Is AI CV Builder BD really free?
faqs.a: Yes. The Free plan has no time limit: create a CV, use the free templates and download it as a PDF without paying, and no card or bKash payment is needed. Premium adds unlimited CVs, every template, watermark-free PDFs and more AI help, and you can try it free first.

faqs.q: What is the best free CV maker in Bangladesh?
faqs.a: Look for one that knows the Bangladeshi format (SSC/HSC, GPA/CGPA, personal details), works in Bangla and English, lets you download a PDF free, makes ATS-readable CVs and works on your phone. AI CV Builder BD was built for exactly that, and you can start free.

faqs.q: Is there a free trial of Premium?
faqs.a: Yes. New accounts can try Premium free for a few days without any payment details. When the trial ends you stay on the Free plan unless you choose to upgrade.

faqs.q: Can I make my CV in Bangla?
faqs.a: Yes. Write your CV in Bangla or English, switch the app language at any time, and use AI to translate your CV between the two.

faqs.q: Can I make a CV on my mobile phone?
faqs.a: Yes. AI CV Builder BD works in your phone's browser, such as Chrome on Android or Safari on iPhone. Fill in the form, check the preview and download your CV as a PDF. No app or computer needed.

faqs.q: Which CV format is used in Bangladesh?
faqs.a: Most employers expect contact details and a photo, a career objective, experience, education with GPA/CGPA, training, skills, personal details and references on 1–2 pages. Our BD templates follow this order.
Templates marked ATS use a single column, standard headings and real text, so applicant tracking systems can read them.

faqs.q: Does the AI make things up?
faqs.a: No. The AI only rewrites what you give it and never adds jobs, degrees or numbers you didn't provide. You review and approve each suggestion.

faqs.q: Is there a CV maker app I need to install?
faqs.a: No. AI CV Builder BD runs in your phone browser like an app, so there is nothing to download. To open it in one tap, add it to your home screen from the browser menu.
